hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, datetime; issues=[]; cf=json.load(open('.ai/CURRENT_FOCUS')); a=(datetime.datetime.now()-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(cf.get('updated_at',''))).days; cf.get('status')=='in_progress' and issues.append(f'Task in progress: {cf[\"task_name\"]}'); l=json.load(open('.ai/memory/lessons.json')); ls=l.get('lessons',[]); ls and (datetime.datetime.now()-datetime.datetime.strptime(max(x['date'] for x in ls),'%Y-%m-%d')).days>30 and issues.append('No new lessons in 30d+'); [print(f'  ⚠️  {i}') for i in issues] or print('  ✓ Harness OK') if not issues else None" 2>&1 || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *guineapig-backend*.go) cd packages/guineapig-backend && go vet ./... 2>&1 && go build ./... 2>&1;; esac; } || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('$f').read())" 2>&1;; esac; } || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *guineapig-backend*.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac; } || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *guineapig-client*.ts|*guineapig-client*.vue) cd packages/guineapig-client && npx vue-tsc --noEmit 2>&1;; *guineapig-ops-web*.ts|*guineapig-ops-web*.vue) cd packages/guineapig-ops-web && npx vue-tsc --noEmit 2>&1;; esac; } || true
jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *Dockerfile*|*docker-compose*|*deployment/*/helm/*) bash scripts/validate_infra.sh "$f" 2>&1;; esac; } || true

echo "=== $(git branch --show-current) ===" && git status -s | head -5 && python3 -c "import json,datetime; cf=json.load(open('.ai/CURRENT_FOCUS')); u=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(cf['updated_at']); print(f'Task: {cf[\"task_name\"]} [{cf[\"status\"]}] ({(datetime.datetime.now()-u).days}d ago)')" 2>&1 || true
